title: Configuration tableau evaluation
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state Turing machine, and let $n,T$ be natural numbers, $z$ a Boolean list, and $x:\{0,1\}^n\to\{0,1\}$ an input assignment. The configuration tableau circuit on input $x$ outputs true exactly when, at some time $s<T$, the transition from the configuration of $M$ on input $z$ followed by the $n$ bits of $x$ emits true.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite-state Turing machine over Boolean symbols
$x$ is a Boolean assignment on $n$ bits
